name: Webbed! [2 Player Obby]
desc:
⚠️THIS GAME IS MADE FOR 2 PLAYERS⚠️

The two spiders 🕷️ have become webbed together 🕸️,  and only through teamwork  can they overcome the tricky terrains ahead. In this 2-player obby, each spider can cling to walls and swing across gaps by shooting their web.

🎁 LIKE AND JOIN THE GROUP FOR A FREE REVIVE 🎁

🛠 If you experience lag, it is recommended you switch to a private server (free).
